Title: Azure Web Sites now supports WebJobs

Body.Content: Run custom jobs (using executables or scripts) on your web site. WebJobs supports running jobs on demand, continuously, or on a schedule, and automates administrative or recurring tasks. See How to Use the WebJobs feature in Azure Web Sites to learn more.
Body.Markdown:
Run custom jobs (using executables or scripts) on your web site. WebJobs supports running jobs on demand, continuously, or on a schedule, and automates administrative or recurring tasks.

See How to Use the WebJobs feature in Azure Web Sites to learn more.
